@graph.name: Security Bundle
@graph.description: Looking for more protection on your trip? Travel Guard’s optional add-on Security Bundle provides extra coverage to give you more protection.

acceptedAnswer.text: There are many reasons you may want added security-related coverage while you’re traveling. Travel Guard’s Security Bundle adds covered reasons related to Civil disorders and Riots on coverages such as Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption – meaning you may be able to cancel or change your travel due to those type of events at your destination and submit a claim for reimbursement of covered expenses. The Security Bundle also adds Security Evacuation to your Travel Guard travel insurance plan. If Travel Guard determines you need to get to a safe location, Travel Guard must make all arrangements. Since the social and political climate of the world is constantly changing, it’s always a good idea to have certain protection to help address the worst-case scenarios. Lastly, the Security Bundle also adds Flight Guard coverage to your travel insurance plan.

mainEntity.name: Can I add the Security Bundle to my existing Travel Guard travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can add the Security Bundle to your existing travel insurance plan at any time before departure as long as it is an available upgrade on your selected plan.

mainEntity.name: Does the Security Bundle provide coverage for Medical Evacuation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, emergency medical evacuation is a separate coverage on your Travel Guard travel insurance plans. An emergency medical evacuation would need to be deemed necessary by a certified health professional, whereas a security evacuation is dependent on Travel Guard’s assessment of the social and political climate of the location you’re in.

mainEntity.name: Who decides if a Security Evacuation should take place?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Security Evacuation may take place if an advisory is placed by a government official involving political or military events, if a Natural Disaster leaves your destination uninhabitable as determined by officials, or if authorities have verified a threat or assault on your physical being. Ultimately, the determination of whether a security evacuation is required will be made by Travel Guard.
